rules.statement: Where one co-owner conveys the entire premises held in common and the grantee enters into possession under the Conveyance claiming title to the whole premises, such possession is adverse to the co-tenants of the granter.
rules.supporting_quote: The learned writer seems to be of the view that when one of several tenants in common conveys the entire premises held in common and the grantee enters into possession under the conveyance claiming title to the whole premises, such possession is adverse to the co-tenants of the granter and consequently at the expiration of the period of limitation they will be barred.

meta.parties: Punchi Et Al. v. Bandi Menika
